+@pytest.mark.parametrize('stdin', [{}], indirect=['stdin'])
+def test_created_files_warn_when_mode_is_omitted(atomic_am, atomic_mocks, mocker):
+    atomic_am.argument_spec['mode'] = dict(type='raw')
+    atomic_am.params['mode'] = None
+    atomic_mocks['path_exists'].return_value = False
+    atomic_am.selinux_enabled.return_value = False
+    atomic_mocks['umask'].side_effect = [0o022, 0, 0o022, 0]
+
+    atomic_am.atomic_move('/src/one', '/dest/one')
+    atomic_am.atomic_move('/src/two', '/dest/two')
+
+    assert atomic_am._created_files == {'/dest/one', '/dest/two'}
+    assert atomic_mocks['chmod'].call_args_list == [mocker.call(b'/dest/one', 0o600),
+                                                   mocker.call(b'/dest/two', 0o600)]
+    warn = mocker.patch.object(atomic_am, 'warn')
+    atomic_am._return_formatted({})
+    assert warn.call_args_list == [
+        mocker.call("File '/dest/one' created with default permissions '600'. The previous default was '666'. Specify 'mode' to avoid this warning."),
+        mocker.call("File '/dest/two' created with default permissions '600'. The previous default was '666'. Specify 'mode' to avoid this warning."),
+    ]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('stdin', [{}], indirect=['stdin'])
+def test_created_file_warning_cleared_by_set_mode(atomic_am, atomic_mocks, mocker):
+    atomic_am.argument_spec['mode'] = dict(type='raw')
+    atomic_am.params['mode'] = None
+    atomic_mocks['path_exists'].return_value = False
+    atomic_am.selinux_enabled.return_value = False
+    atomic_am.atomic_move('/src', '/dest')
+
+    assert atomic_am._created_files == {'/dest'}
+    mocker.patch('os.lstat', return_value=os.stat_result((0o100600, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)))
+    atomic_am.set_mode_if_different('/dest', 0o600, False)
+    assert atomic_am._created_files == set()
+    warn = mocker.patch.object(atomic_am, 'warn')
+    atomic_am._return_formatted({})
+    assert not warn.called
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('has_mode, mode', [(False, None), (True, '0640')])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('stdin', [{}], indirect=['stdin'])
+def test_created_file_not_tracked_without_omitted_mode(atomic_am, atomic_mocks, has_mode, mode):
+    if has_mode:
+        atomic_am.argument_spec['mode'] = dict(type='raw')
+        atomic_am.params['mode'] = mode
+    atomic_mocks['path_exists'].return_value = False
+    atomic_am.selinux_enabled.return_value = False
+
+    atomic_am.atomic_move('/src', '/dest')
+
+    assert atomic_am._created_files == set()
+
+
